req.title: Update unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when PUT targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-011 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} returns HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. To achieve high mutation kill rate we need: (1) a positive test confirming a known-existing task CAN be updated (kills mutations that always return 404), (2) a negative test confirming a clearly non-existent id returns exactly 404 with the correct detail message (kills status-code constant mutations and string mutations), (3) a boundary test at task_id=21 (one above the highest seeded id=20) to catch off-by-one mutations in the lookup, (4) a boundary test at task_id=0 / negative id to confirm those also return 404, and (5) a decision-table test covering the boolean branch: task found → 200, task not found → 404, asserting both sides of the if-None check. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory database seeded with the specified rows.

tests.name: test_put_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Database contains task with id=1 (title='Read chapter 5', completed=true)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Send PUT /tasks/1 with JSON body {"title": "Updated title", "completed": false}
expected: Response JSON contains id=1, title='Updated title', completed=false
trace: R-TASK-011 — positive path: existing task must NOT return 404; kills mutations that always raise 404
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='desc', completed=True))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_existing_task_returns_200():
    r = client.put('/tasks/1', json={'title': 'Updated title', 'completed': False})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Updated title'
    assert body['completed'] == False

test_put_existing_task_returns_200()

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine5 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})

Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine5)
db5 = Session5()
for i in range(1, 21):
    db5.add(models.Task(id=i, title=f'Task {i}', completed=False))
db5.commit(); db5.close()

def override5():
    s = Session5()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_put_both_sides_found_vs_not_found():
